description: This source file defines a command module for resolving, ensuring, and managing the runtime environment for an external tool named 'pi'. It includes functions to locate the executable, decide if a runtime needs to be materialized, and install it if necessary, with synchronization to prevent concurrent installations.

methods.name: resolveDocsPiCommand
methods.description: Resolves the 'pi' command executable path, either from environment variables, system PATH, or by ensuring a materialized runtime is installed.

methods.name: shouldMaterializePiRuntime
methods.description: Determines if the 'pi' runtime should be installed based on its symlink path.

methods.name: ensureMaterializedPiRuntime
methods.description: Ensures that the 'pi' runtime environment is installed and available, installing it if necessary, and returns the command to execute it.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiRuntimeDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where the materialized 'pi' runtime is stored, based on user cache or temp directory.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiPackageVersion
methods.description: Returns the package version of the materialized 'pi' runtime, either from environment variable or default.
